name: Salesforce
one_liner: Cloud CRM platform (Sales Cloud etc.) exposing REST, SOAP, Bulk, Pub/Sub and GraphQL APIs on customer orgs.
auth_notes: No static API key: OAuth access token from a Connected App or External Client App registered in the org; flows include client credentials, JWT bearer, PKCE/auth code (activepieces guide, 2026-11-19). Username+password+token and sf CLI login also used by community tools. Official docs return HTTP 403 to the fetcher.
access_notes: API access included in Enterprise, Unlimited, Performance and Developer (free dev org); Professional needs a paid API add-on; Essentials has none (third-party guide citing Salesforce Help, read 2026-11-19). Commercial multi-tenant apps are said to need AppExchange Partner Program enrolment under updated API terms (Sliick, third party).

buildability.rationale: Rich documented APIs with standard OAuth and free Developer Edition orgs for building, but customer production access depends on edition (Enterprise+ or paid add-on) and commercial apps may need AppExchange partner enrolment. Official docs unfetchable, so claims rely on third-party summaries.

needs_human_reason: developer.salesforce.com and help.salesforce.com returned 403 or a JS shell, so edition gating and partner-program terms rest on third-party pages. Official MCP (salesforcecli/mcp, local @salesforce/mcp) reached end of life 2026-11-02 and the repo is archived; any hosted successor is unverified.
